why: Controls below this project's own 28px coarse-pointer floor, recorded so the count cannot grow while the existing set is triaged. Not an allowance: every one of these is a real shortfall. Resizing them changes how the plugin feels and how nearly every capture looks, which is an operator decision rather than a repair one pass should make silently.
smallest: db-file-tag-remove at 10x14, db-multi-select-remove at 14x14, db-table-row-drag-handle at 16x16
note: db-toggle-switch measures 34x18 under a coarse pointer here, which is a second independent contradiction of roadmap 7.1's claim that the switch reaches 34x28.
lastTriage: 228 -> 215 on 2026-09-02, and the ratchet is lowered because the shortfall it recorded was repaired. The invalid-events modal's twelve controls were the reason 224 became 228: `db-invalid-event-row-fix` declared `height: 24px` and the modal's datetime inputs measured 19px tall, and none of them appeared in the coarse-pointer raise list beside their siblings. They are in it now, and nine controls that measured under the floor in that fixture measure 0 under it. Thirteen fewer in total, measured twice at 215 before this number was written. A ratchet that is not lowered when the defect is fixed stops recording anything. Previously, 224 -> 228 on 2026-09-02, recording those twelve rather than resizing them; and 286 -> 224 on 2026-09-01, when `db-list-row-open` (36) and `db-source-rule-icon-button` (26) were raised under coarse pointer. The rest of the 215 are untouched and still await the operator decision the `why` describes.
